description: Self-register the configured agent (AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY) on the 8004Swap Registry so it's allowed to trade. One-time action per address; fails if already registered. Broadcasts a real (testnet) transaction.

metadataURI.description: Optional metadata URI for this agent, defaults to empty string

ownerAddress.description: Address allowed to pause/manage this agent later; defaults to the agent's own address

name: register_agent
